summary: First testing iteration of HomeIVF CRM. Backend pytest suite (32 tests) covering auth, leads CRUD/filters/group-by/bulk/lost-restore, chatter, activities, reports (dashboard + pivot), catalogs, templates, whatsapp, users, webhooks, and RBAC — all 32 passed (100%). Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright across Login, Dashboard, Leads (list/pagination/kanban), Lead Detail, Reports (pivot run), Templates, Admin (users tab), WhatsApp inbox (10,936 channels), Follow-ups (overdue/today/upcoming tabs), and caller RBAC — all working visually.

issues: Console warning at mount: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart renders fine after layout settles but log is noisy; consider explicit min-width/height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts ResponsiveContainer mount-time width/height warning by giving the chart wrapper a defined min-height (cosmetic, not user-facing).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/leads.py build_query: `if lead_stage == '__none__'` block is unreachable because it follows `if lead_stage:` which already sets q['lead_stage']; refactor to elif so '__none__' (no-stage) filter actually works.

routes/auth.py login: lockout window is rolling — every failed attempt resets locked_until via $set, meaning the 15-min window restarts on each failure (instead of staying fixed from the 5th fail). Use $setOnInsert or only update locked_until once count hits threshold.
Backend has no /api prefix mismatch checks: webhook public endpoint /api/webhook/lead/{token} confirmed reachable without auth — good. But ensure rate-limiting added before production.
Leads endpoint runs count_documents on every list call with potentially expensive filters on 99k+ docs; consider estimated/total cap or skipping count on deep pagination.
Frontend Login.jsx shows 'Invalid email or password' inline (good). Same component should also display 429 lockout message distinctly so users know to wait 15 min.

seed_data_creation: Created during tests: TEST_pytest_lead, TEST_webhook_lead (via public webhook), TEST_tag_<ts>, TEST_activity, TEST_note_pytest, TEST_webhook_<ts>. Lead IDs >= 500000 are test-generated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-use /app/backend/tests/test_homeivf_api.py as regression suite (pytest from /app/backend). Background odoo_migrate process still importing chatter messages — totals may rise over time, but all asserts use lower-bound thresholds so tests remain stable. /api/templates uses /api/templates/{channel} (path param, not query). /api/catalogs returns a single dict keyed by type. /api/users returns a plain list. /api/reports/pivot expects `cols` as a STRING (not list).
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. The only initial false positive (wrong-password error not visible) was a test-script issue — the UI does render an 'Invalid email or password' message; the first pass simply didn't wait long enough and the broader regex caught body marketing text first.
